definitions.explanation: A square shape. As a prefix it means "square, squared" (a square hanger, squared lumber); after a measurement it gives the side of a square or cube, as in recipes: "2 cm cubes".
In geometry, an angle: the figure formed by two lines meeting at a point.

examples.japanese: {角|かく}⟦ハンガー→ハンガー：08275_hangaa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦タオル→タオル：01533_taoru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{干|ほ}す→干す：00115_hosu⟧。
examples.english: I hang the towels on a square hanger.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大根|だいこん}→大根：05186_daikon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧2⟦センチ→センチ：01372_senchi⟧{角|かく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧。

⟦{柱|はしら}→柱：05009_hashira⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{太|ふと}い→太い：02955_futoi⟧⟦{角材|かくざい}→角材：28391_kakuzai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{使|つか}われていて→使う：00473_tsukau⟧、⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{丈夫|じょうぶ}→丈夫：01156_joubu⟧だ。
examples.english: Thick squared timbers are used for the pillars, so the house is very sturdy.

examples.japanese: {角|かく}A⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{大|おお}きさ→大きさ：10969_ookisa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}めよ→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
examples.english: Find the size of angle A.
The three angles of a triangle add up to 180 degrees.

examples.japanese: ⟦{二|ふた}つ→二つ：02953_futatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{直線|ちょくせん}→直線：05440_chokusen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{交|まじ}わって→交わる：18379_majiwaru⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧{角|かく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧、⟦{分度器|ぶんどき}→分度器：05596_bundoki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{測|はか}って→測る：01977_hakaru⟧みよう。
examples.english: Let's measure the angle formed where the two straight lines cross with a protractor.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- 〜⟦センチ→センチ：01372_senchi⟧{角|かく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧: to cut into ~-centimeter cubes (recipes)
- {角|かく}⟦ハンガー→ハンガー：08275_hangaa⟧: square clothes hanger with many pegs
- ⟦{角材|かくざい}→角材：28391_kakuzai⟧: squared lumber
- ⟦{角砂糖|かくざとう}→角砂糖：18293_kakuzatou⟧: sugar cube
- ⟦{直角|ちょっかく}→直角：05444_chokkaku⟧: right angle

WATCH OUT:
The same kanji has three other everyday readings: ⟦{角|かど}→角：02195_kado⟧ (corner of a street or object), ⟦{角|すみ}→角：02156_sumi⟧ (inside corner), ⟦{角|つの}→角：02158_tsuno⟧ (horn). かく appears mainly in compounds, recipes and math.
